# Kavo

> A production-grade CRUD framework for TypeScript: define an entity once (via TypeORM, Prisma, Mongoose, or MikroORM) and get the full REST CRUD surface — filtering, sorting, pagination, nested includes, field selection, optional per-operation DTOs, transactions, and problem-details errors — behind generated NestJS routes, configurable at global → entity → operation → per-call scope. GraphQL and MCP bindings expose the same engine over other protocols.

Source: https://github.com/kavo-labs/kavo

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://kavo.js.org/getting-started/introduction): What Kavo is and when to reach for it
- [Requirements](https://kavo.js.org/getting-started/requirements): Supported Node, TypeScript, and framework versions
- [Installation](https://kavo.js.org/getting-started/installation): Installing core, an ORM adapter, and the Nest binding
- [Quick Start](https://kavo.js.org/getting-started/quick-start): Wiring a first entity end to end

## Core

- [Entities](https://kavo.js.org/core/entities): Defining an entity and its infrastructure seam
- [CRUD Operations](https://kavo.js.org/core/crud-operations): The standard operation registry (createOne/createMany, findOne/findMany, updateOne, patchOne, deleteOne)
- [DTOs](https://kavo.js.org/core/dtos): create/update/patch/query/item/list DTO slots and derivation
- [Services](https://kavo.js.org/core/services): The typed DefaultKavoService programmatic front door
- [Routes & Controllers](https://kavo.js.org/core/routes-and-controllers): Decoration-time route generation and manual-method-wins
- [Custom Operations](https://kavo.js.org/core/custom-operations): Adding, overriding, or disabling operations

## Querying

- [Filtering](https://kavo.js.org/querying/filtering): The filter operator grammar (eq, gte, isNotNull, ...)
- [Search](https://kavo.js.org/querying/search): Free-text search across allowlisted fields
- [Sorting](https://kavo.js.org/querying/sorting): The `sort` query parameter
- [Pagination](https://kavo.js.org/querying/pagination): Offset, cursor, since, and none pagination strategies
- [Field Selection & Includes](https://kavo.js.org/querying/field-selection-and-includes): `fields` and `include` on the wire

## Features

- [Relations](https://kavo.js.org/features/relations): Associating and writing relations by id
- [Soft Delete](https://kavo.js.org/features/soft-delete): Config-declared soft-delete operations and `withDeleted`
- [Realtime Events](https://kavo.js.org/features/realtime-events): Publishing CRUD events over SSE and other transports
- [Caching & ETags](https://kavo.js.org/features/caching-and-etags): Content-hash ETags and conditional requests
- [Allowlists & Computed Fields](https://kavo.js.org/features/allowlists-and-computed-fields): Restricting filter/sort/select and serializer-evaluated computed fields

## Integrations

- [TypeORM](https://kavo.js.org/integrations/orms/typeorm): The @kavo/typeorm adapter
- [Prisma](https://kavo.js.org/integrations/orms/prisma): The @kavo/prisma adapter and marker-class entity identities
- [Mongoose](https://kavo.js.org/integrations/orms/mongoose): The @kavo/mongoose adapter
- [MikroORM](https://kavo.js.org/integrations/orms/mikroorm): The @kavo/mikroorm adapter
- [GraphQL](https://kavo.js.org/integrations/protocols/graphql): The @kavo/graphql schema binding
- [MCP](https://kavo.js.org/integrations/protocols/mcp): The @kavo/mcp tool binding

- [Settings](https://kavo.js.org/guides/configuration/settings): The full KavoSettings reference
